output.summary:
**Heaven’s Door Bootleg Series Vol. III** is a **2021 limited release** from **Heaven’s Door Spirits**. It is a **13-year-old Kentucky bourbon** bottled at **cask strength**, and the official Heaven’s Door description says it was **finished in Spanish wine barrels**. ([heavensdoor.com](https://www.heavensdoor.com/bootleg-series))

More specifically, corroborating bottle-specific sources identify the finishing casks as **Vino de Naranja casks** from Spain, with one retailer listing the bottle at **121.2 proof / 60.6% ABV**. The official producer page and PR release confirm the 13-year age statement, Kentucky bourbon base, cask-strength presentation, and 2021 Vol. III release. ([heavensdoor.com](https://www.heavensdoor.com/bootleg-series))
